Fetch an author's works by ORCID iD: 16 characters in four groups (e.g. 0000-0002-8060-444X); the checksum is checked before anything is fetched.
Records come from ORCID, Scopus, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex and Crossref, fetched directly by your browser; no CollabNET server sits in between.
Scopus needs your own Elsevier API key: click the key icon in the top bar. By default the key is kept in memory for this session only.
Hit an HTTP 429 rate limit? CollabNET retries with exponential backoff and falls back to the Crossref resolver automatically.
Edges use Newman fractional weighting: a paper with n authors adds 1/(n-1) to each co-author pair, so huge consortium papers do not dominate.
Use the edge weight slider to drop weak or one-off co-authorships and keep the core collaborations.
Tick "Extract statistical backbone (disparity filter)" to keep only significant ties; a lower alpha gives a sparser backbone.
Community detection offers Leiden (modularity, recommended) and Louvain; colour nodes by community to see research groups.
Betweenness centrality counts how often an author lies on the shortest paths between others: high values mark brokers between groups.
PageRank (damping 0.85) rewards authors who collaborate with well-connected authors; coreness (k-core) finds the densely connected centre.
Cut-vertex highlighting marks articulation points in red: removing one of those authors splits the network.
The Ego & Brokerage tab analyses each author's neighbourhood: structural constraint, effective network size and Burt's structural holes.
Venn diagrams compare up to 4 sets; UpSet plots show larger combinations of overlaps without the clutter.
Layout engines: Fruchterman-Reingold (force-directed), DrL (fast for large networks), Kamada-Kawai, or a background Web Worker.
Turn the network physics off to drag nodes into place by hand without them springing back.
Hamiltonian diagnostics check Dirac's and Ore's conditions on the collaboration graph.
The authorship position chart shows how often authors appear first, second, corresponding or as co-authors.
Prefer a dark screen? The moon button in the top bar switches to dark mode.
Keyboard users: press Tab through the top bar; each icon button shows its label when focused.
The first visit downloads R and its packages into your browser; later visits load from the browser cache and start much faster.
